data.title: Build a Personal Portfolio
data.outcome: Use project evidence to show what you can do and make it easy for visitors to learn about and contact you.

stages.title: Let visitors quickly understand who you are
stages.action: Clearly state your role, strengths, and the action you want visitors to take.
stages.evidence: The first screen explains your positioning without relying on vague slogans.

lessons.title: Hero
lessons.tagline: Use the opening area to explain the page's main point and next step

lessons.title: Typography
lessons.tagline: Use text size and style to show what matters first

lessons.title: Avatar
lessons.tagline: Represent a person, team, or organization visually

stages.title: Organize your work into browsable projects
stages.action: Choose a small set of representative projects and explain the problem, process, and result.
stages.evidence: Each project demonstrates a specific skill.

lessons.title: Card Grid
lessons.tagline: Arrange similar cards in a responsive grid

lessons.title: Card
lessons.tagline: Keep information about one item in a single block

lessons.title: Tag
lessons.tagline: Mark a status, category, or selected condition with short text

stages.title: Present images, video, and files properly
stages.action: Add the necessary media, descriptions, and load-failure states to each project.
stages.evidence: Media helps visitors understand the project without slowing down or interrupting their reading.

lessons.title: Image
lessons.tagline: Display an image with the right size, crop, and fallback

lessons.title: Video
lessons.tagline: Media with moving images and a duration that plays on a page

lessons.title: File
lessons.tagline: A UI row or card that shows one document, image, or attachment and its status

stages.title: Make it easy for the right people to contact you
stages.action: Provide a clear way to get in touch and any needed external links.
stages.evidence: The main contact action works on both desktop and mobile.

lessons.title: CTA
lessons.tagline: Tell visitors the next action you want them to take

lessons.title: Link
lessons.tagline: Click to open another page, location, or file

lessons.title: Footer
lessons.tagline: End the page with useful links, identity, and required information
